nodes.label: red.js (CLI)
nodes.desc: Argument parsing, settings.js resolution, semver guard for Node >=22.9, express app assembly and signal handling.

nodes.label: lib/red.js
nodes.desc: The embeddable RED object: init wires runtime and editor-api together; start runs runtime.start then api.start.

nodes.label: runtime init/start
nodes.desc: Creates nodeApp/adminApp express apps, guards unhandled websocket upgrades, then runs the storage→settings→nodes→flows start chain.

nodes.label: nodes facade
nodes.desc: Runtime-internal nodes module: registerType plus loadFlows/startFlows/stopFlows/setFlows delegates.

nodes.label: editor-api init
nodes.desc: Creates the admin express app, auth login/token routes, mounts the editor app and the admin API app.

nodes.label: admin routes
nodes.desc: needsPermission-guarded endpoints: /flows, /flow/:id, /nodes, /context/:scope, /settings, /plugins, /diagnostics.

nodes.label: POST /flows handler
nodes.desc: Reads Node-RED-Deployment-Type header (full/nodes/flows/reload) and forwards to runtimeAPI.flows.setFlows.

nodes.label: websocket server
nodes.desc: ws.Server attached via upgrade at <adminRoot>/comms; auth packets, subscribe messages, keepalive heartbeat.

nodes.label: editor page
nodes.desc: Renders index.mst with theme context and serves the built editor-client assets from @node-red/editor-client/public.

nodes.label: flows API
nodes.desc: async-mutex serializes setFlows/addFlow/updateFlow; rev mismatch raises version_mismatch with status 409.

nodes.label: comms API
nodes.desc: Subscribes to runtime events and publishes them to every connection; retained topics replay on subscribe with MQTT-style wildcards.

nodes.label: loadFlows
nodes.desc: storage.getFlows then credentials.load; emits runtime-state so the editor knows the flow revision.

nodes.label: setFlows (deploy)
nodes.desc: Clone config, parseConfig, diffConfigs against active config, save flows+credentials, then stop→context.clean→start.

nodes.label: start(type,diff)
nodes.desc: Checks missing types and safe mode; full deploys create every Flow, modified deploys update only changed ones, then awaits each start(diff).

nodes.label: stop(type,diff)
nodes.desc: Computes which flows/nodes to stop from the diff and tears them down before the new config starts.

nodes.label: class Flow
nodes.desc: Per-tab object holding activeNodes, groups, catch/status nodes; its constructor already attaches the flow-level context.

nodes.label: Flow.start(diff)
nodes.desc: Orders groups outermost-first, retries config node dependencies, creates nodes via flowUtil.createNode, rewires changed nodes.

nodes.label: Flow.send hooks
nodes.desc: handleOnSend→preRoute→preDeliver hook stages; preRoute resolves the destination node and clones the message when required.

nodes.label: deliverMessage
nodes.desc: Delivers via destination.node.receive inside setImmediate unless runtimeSyncDelivery forces synchronous delivery.

nodes.label: function Node
nodes.desc: Captures id/type/z, hides _flow/_module as non-enumerable, and calls updateWires with the configured wires array.

nodes.label: updateWires
nodes.desc: Three send strategies: NOOP when unwired, cached _wire for a single output-target, full wires iteration otherwise.

nodes.label: Node.send
nodes.desc: Builds SendEvents per output/wire, stamps _msgid, marks cloneMessage for the second send, then hands the batch to _flow.send.

nodes.label: receive → input
nodes.desc: receive stamps _msgid and emits input; onReceive hook fires first, then the node callback with (msg, send, done).

nodes.label: Node.close
nodes.desc: Runs close callbacks (async ones get a done callback), removes input listeners and deletes the node's context.

nodes.label: registry.js
nodes.desc: nodeConstructors map keyed by type; registerNodeConstructor rejects duplicates and emits type-registered.

nodes.label: loader.js
nodes.desc: load() asks localfilesystem for node files in core dirs plus userDir node_modules, then loads modules, nodes and plugins.

nodes.label: loadNodeSet
nodes.desc: Requires the node's JS file, parses its HTML edit template, and registers the declared types.

nodes.label: context module
nodes.desc: contexts map keyed by scope, stores map with a default store, and $parent traversal for subflow context lookups.

nodes.label: store plugins
nodes.desc: load() instantiates stores from settings.contextStorage; 'default' can alias another store, else first listed wins.

nodes.label: getContext(id,flow)
nodes.desc: Lazily creates a context keyed nodeId:flowId with flow and global attached; parseContextStore picks the store per key.

nodes.label: Memory store
nodes.desc: Default store: a plain object data map per scope with get/set/keys/clean; lost on restart by design.

nodes.label: storage module
nodes.desc: Pluggable storage interface: with projects enabled getFlows/saveFlows delegate to the projects module.
